notes: Nill Download Manager 2.3.0 adds a second door for video: a video already playing in the browser can be handed to NDM by the extension as a ready download — the path that works on Windows 8, where the built-in video engine's JavaScript runtime cannot run — while the picker keeps both sources side by side and downloads each video once. File downloads now open the same download card the video picker uses, with size, resume support, folder, category, queue and rename fields. The window no longer freezes when checking for updates or when adding a link whose server is slow to answer; both now run in the background and the update check stops cleanly after 60 seconds. FTP links are accepted in Add URL and batch add with resume; deleting a download that is still running removes its partial file; Start Queue resumes paused downloads in the queue; the list can be sorted by name, size, date or status; a progress window that was closed stays closed; paused rows read Paused; long error messages wrap; and the Scheduler window fits 720p screens. On Windows, list sorting and the download card arrive in the next update.
